name: Video reformat
pitch: Convert horizontal videos to vertical with safe zone overlays for social platforms.
instructions: Convert horizontal videos to vertical format with safe zone overlays for social platforms. Begin by listing the video files in the workspace using file_read. For each video file found, run the ffmpeg command to resize to vertical resolution (1080x1920) and add a safe zone overlay using the drawtext filter. After processing, list the output files and show their names and sizes to the person. If no video files are found, say so and ask if they want to add files. If ffmpeg is not available, say that the tool is not connected and ask if they want to install it. Never invent video dimensions or overlay text; use the standard safe zone rectangle for the target platform.

examples.does: list files, run ffmpeg to resize and overlay, show output

skills.name: reformat-video
skills.description: Resize and overlay a video for vertical platforms
skills.body: 1. Use file_read to list all video files in the workspace. 2. For each video, run shell_run with ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -vf "scale=1080:1920,drawtext=text='Safe zone':x=(w-overlay_w)/2:y=(h-overlay_h)/2" output.mp4. 3. Use file_read again to confirm the new file exists. 4. Show the person the list of output files with their sizes.

readme:
# Video reformat
Convert horizontal videos to vertical format with safe zone overlays for social platforms.

What it does: Resizes videos to 1080x1920 and adds a centered safe zone rectangle.

What it needs: shell_run (ffmpeg), file_read, file_write.

What it will not do: It will not crop faces or add custom branding; it only places a safe zone overlay.
